title: private-installer: add runbooks-as-code + multi-AZ DR automation (Terraform + Helm + upgrade/rollback tooling)
author: Priya Raman
description: Motivation: Customers running Redwood Private in regulated environments asked for reproducible, testable HA and DR runbooks that can be executed as code during restore drills and failovers. This PR introduces runbooks-as-code for the private-installer, multi-AZ Terraform helpers for cross-AZ restore automation, Helm chart changes to improve pod distribution and probe behavior, and a small CLI-assisted upgrade/rollback hook to automate safe rollouts across AZs. Scope: add runbooks-as-code under installer/runbooks/ with executable workflows for failover, controlled restore drills, and post-restore validation; new Terraform modules and example workspace for multi-AZ restore orchestration and DR failover; Helm chart tweaks: requiredDuringScheduling anti-affinity by default for stateful components, configurable podTopologiesSpread for multi-AZ clusters, better readiness/liveness probes for kv-cache and gateway, and chart values to opt into DR mode; small CLI tool upgradectl that coordinates canary upgrades across AZs and exposes a rollback path that drains traffic and reverts configuration via Helm rollback + terraform state promotion. Changes are additive and opt-in. Testing: unit tests for runbooks parsing and dry-run executor, integration test harness for terraform module using localstack and KIND combined with perf-canary infra to verify cross-AZ failover behavior, and e2e restore drill smoke tests in internal staging. Rollback and safety: upgradectl supports dry-run, pause points, automatic rollback on health-check regressions, and emits tracer spans for Redwood Console. Runbook authors can annotate steps with Linear keys to trace to tickets. Related: ENG-1274 (DR automation design), ENG-1399 (private-installer multi-AZ), PM-88 (customer ask for runbook automation). This PR keeps sensitive configuration out of the repository; examples use placeholders and documented secrets handling.

release_notes: Add runbooks-as-code for private-installer to automate HA/DR drills and failovers. Introduce terraform multi_az_dr module and example workspace for cross-AZ restore orchestration. Helm chart updates to improve pod distribution and probes. Add upgradectl to orchestrate canary upgrades with automated rollback on health regressions. Opt-in changes with documentation and tests.
